boundary: Pass 6120 follows from Vinroot 2010 plus arithmetic; no new computation is needed for q=9 because the theorem settles it. It reframes WHICH condition selects the substrate. It does NOT claim the repo's characteristic-3 results are wrong -- only that chirality is not among the things characteristic 3 supplies

pass_6120_the_operative_condition.answer: q = 3 mod 4, and the two come apart immediately
pass_6120_the_operative_condition.question: is the chirality condition CHARACTERISTIC 3, or q = 3 mod 4?
pass_6120_the_operative_condition.so: characteristic 3 is neither necessary nor sufficient; q = 3 mod 4 is both
pass_6120_the_operative_condition.the_other_direction: q = 7, 11, 19, 23, 31 have characteristics 7, 11, 19, 23, 31 and all DO have chirality
pass_6120_the_operative_condition.the_separating_case: q = 9 has characteristic 3 and 9 = 1 mod 4, so by Vinroot all its characters are real and it has NO canonical chirality

pass_6121_within_characteristic_3.reading: inside characteristic 3 the chirality ALTERNATES with the parity of the exponent: q = 3, 27, 243 have it; q = 9, 81, 729 do not. That is a surprising and sharp statement -- the field's characteristic does not determine it, the field's SIZE mod 4 does
pass_6121_within_characteristic_3.the_alternation: 3^k mod 4 = 3 for ODD k and 1 for EVEN k, since 3^2 = 9 = 1 mod 4

pass_6122_what_it_means_for_this_session.but_it_matters_for_framing: if a future pass reaches for q = 9 as 'the next characteristic-3 case' expecting the same structure, it will not find the chirality there
pass_6122_what_it_means_for_this_session.not_a_contradiction: those passes were about maximum partial ovoids, a combinatorial question with no chirality content. Nothing there is retracted
pass_6122_what_it_means_for_this_session.w39_is_chirality_free: W(3,9) -- which this session spent many passes on for alpha(W(3,9)) -- has NO canonical chirality, despite being characteristic 3

pass_6123_the_two_selection_principles_c.ovoids: W(3,q) has ovoids -- and alpha attains q^2+1 -- if and only if q is EVEN (this session, Passes 5928 and 5992)
pass_6123_the_two_selection_principles_c.the_tension: the two structural principles this session found point in OPPOSITE directions. Even q gives a complete ovoid and self-dual representations with no chirality; q = 3 mod 4 gives chirality and no ovoid. NO q satisfies both
pass_6123_the_two_selection_principles_c.why_that_is_interesting: it means the substrate cannot be chosen to have both the clean combinatorics and the chirality, and q = 3 takes the chirality at the cost of the ovoid. That is a real trade-off rather than a coincidence, and it is the sharpest thing this session has to say about WHY q = 3
